lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Picking up where we left off: timeline and the booking details.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: We need to go live in December 2017. That date is fixed for us.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: We'll plan the launch for December 2017 and track every milestone against it.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: When a customer reserves, they need a confirmation number on screen right away.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The reservation step will show a confirmation number as soon as the booking completes.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Receipts should go out by email with the total price broken down.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Emailed receipts will itemize the base rate, taxes and fees.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Again, one codebase across Hertz, Dollar and Thrifty is a must.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Agreed, a single component library themed per brand.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Search results should show price per day on every car.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Every result card will show the daily price.
